response.justification: Bogdan is a versatile, experienced software craftsman with 15+ years across web, mobile, and embedded systems, but his recent and dominant expertise is in TypeScript/Node.js full-stack and D-language development, not C++. His only substantial C++ work was a brief 6-month stint in 2014-2015 and a university thesis project, far short of the 8-12 years of C++-focused experience required. There is no evidence of message brokers, MQTT, IEC 62443 security standards, or industrial automation/IoT protocol experience central to this role.
strengths: Deep, broad engineering experience (15+ years) across many stacks and paradigms
Strong low-latency, async I/O, and multi-threaded systems experience (via DLang at Sociomantic)
Demonstrated mentoring, workshop facilitation, and technical communication skills
concerns: Minimal recent C++ experience (last significant use ~2014-2015, plus a student project)
No evidence of MQTT, message brokers, REST/IoT platform work, or IEC 62443/SDL security practices
No mention of UML, formal architecture documentation, or industrial protocols (Modbus, OPC UA, etc.)

key_factors.factor: Lack of current C++ depth required for role
Strong general software engineering and systems experience
